environment.description: Flask application deployed on a single EC2 instance behind an AWS Network Load Balancer (NLB) with TLS passthrough. No reverse proxy adding security headers. Application served directly via gunicorn with gevent worker on port 5000. Security group allows inbound 80/443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional middleware or header injection configured. WebSocket upgrade requests pass through unmodified.

config.load_balancer: NLB with TLS passthrough (no header manipulation)
